title: Evaluator judgment output v1
description: Structured output of an LLM evaluator for one Evaluation: its judgment over the deterministic check results and the attempt's action sequence (ADR-0013). The model never produces check results; those are observations recorded by the harness. Mapping: 'success' and 'rationale' fill the evaluation.completed v1 payload (the harness adds evaluation_id, evaluator, lab_instance_id, checks and provenance); each 'evidence' item becomes one evidence.created v1 payload with the item's fields copied verbatim (the harness adds evidence_id and evaluation_id). Field schemas are taken from those payloads by $ref. Harness-side checks: each skill_id must be a skill under test in the attempt's Definition; each supporting_event_id must be an event given to the model in this call; dimension must be in the pack-declared vocabulary.

success.description: Overall judgment of the attempt. A passing final check is not by itself success at the skill.

rationale.description: Why the overall judgment was made. Non-null here; evaluation.completed allows null only for evaluations without an LLM.

evidence.description: Evidence items, one per (skill, dimension) judgment. May be empty when the attempt shows nothing to judge.

items.title: Evidence item
items.description: Accidental success, hint dependence and systematic diagnosis are expressed through signal + dimension (pack vocabulary) + rationale, not as a verdict on the final state.
